description: Mreža autocesta Hrvatskih autocesta – WMS INSPIRE is a dataset listed in NIPP Geoportal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.hac.hr. The Croatian Motorways Network contains data on the geometry of the motorway axis under the management of Hrvatske autoceste d.o.o. in accordance with the Ordinance on the content, structure and manner of keeping a database on public roads and facilities on them. Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Croatian Motorways Network - WMS INSPIRE" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include javne ceste, inspiregeoportal, ceste, autoceste, baza cesta. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
